Changes:   None. The model is redistributed unmodified (the SHA-256 above); this project did no training,

Scope:     This notice states the licence of the model file only. anmitsu's own code is under the project's

History:   At the pinned revision the upstream label was apache-2.0; zenz-LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt is kept as a
           record of that label. It is not the model's current licence label and is not presented as a sufficient
           notice on its own. This notice does not claim that the earlier grant was revoked.

Not established: the model's training data and its relation to any base model (the model card does not describe
           them). This notice makes no statement about them.
